texto: The verb **dürfen** indicates official authorization or moral permission:
**Hier darf man parken.** (Here parking is allowed).
**Darf ich das Fenster öffnen?** (Can I open the window? / May I open it?).
In German, deny * dürfen * equals **estar terminantemente prohibido**:
**Hier darf man nicht rauchen.** (You cannot smoke here / smoking is prohibited).
**Im Museum darf man nicht fotografieren.** (The museum is not allowed to take photos).
It is used for general rules applicable to everyone (equivalent to the impersonal «se» in Spanish: * man darf * = is allowed, * man darf nicht * = is not allowed).

filas: absence of obligation (not to have why)
